message_en: A rounding difference of 0.01 SAR must be posted to account 5199, which requires a cost centre. Set a default cost centre for the company, then lock again.
scenario_description: fixture: stored slip nets sum 0.01 below component sums (drift); ROUNDING line must be posted to 5199 (Required) and company has NO default cost centre. With default CC-100 the line posts as a CREDIT of 0.01 to 5199 on CC-100 (AM-34: the net is 0.01 below the component sums, so debits exceed credits and the missing amount is a credit) and Lock succeeds
